title: Damage Allowance Credit Line on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Credit covered.** The damage allowance on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent of the order total, when covered cosmetic damage was reported at the customer handover and the customer's damage claim already records the choice to keep the item with an allowance. The allowance is booked once, as a damage allowance credit against that claim.

**Business effect.** Booking the allowance adds one damage allowance credit line, dated today, against the damage claim, lowers the order's balance due by the allowance and marks the claim completed today. The customer sees the credit on the order and the claim closed.

## Tool: `post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89`

**Capability.** Books the damage allowance on a special order whose customer has already chosen, on their damage claim, to keep a cosmetically damaged item with an allowance.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the tool name `post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89` and the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `special_order_id` | the reference number of the special order the damaged item belongs to, as returned by the special order lookup for this customer | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `special_request_id` | the reference number of the damage claim on that order, as returned by the special order request lookup | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `allowance_amount` | the allowance to credit | US dollars as a plain number with 2 decimal places (for example 512.30); the tool rounds to the nearest cent |

No parameter has an enumerated set of values.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that begins "Damage allowance credited" when the credit was recorded, carrying the credit line reference number (text starting "sodmg"), the damage claim reference number, the allowance credited (US dollars, 2 decimals) and the order's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals, negative when money is owed back).

## Reference questions

**Does the tool record the customer's remedy choice?** No. It acts on a claim that already records the choice to keep the item with an allowance; it books the credit line and marks the claim completed.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** An allowance of 512.30 on an order whose balance due was 0.00 returns a negative balance due of 512.30: that amount is owed back to the customer.
